meaning: Import the prior Fitch certificate and use the union of its epistemic and modal relations. Old modal edges preserve old biconditional witnesses; on new epistemic edges symmetry lets knowledge at the endpoint supply truth at the starting world. The reflexive symmetric line includes E and retains biconditional restricted knowability with actual ignorance, while explicit edges0–1 and0–2 without1–2 refute Euclideanness. No actual metaphysical interpretation or global minimality is claimed.
